description: Look up a company by its LinkedIn company or showcase page URL (`url`). Optional sections add data to the answer and to the cost of the call: `fundingData`, `exitData`, `acquisitions`, `extra`, `activities`. Ask only for the sections you need: each one adds data, and most add to the cost. `maxAgeSeconds` is the oldest cached copy you accept (default 30 days, usually answered in seconds). A small value starts a live lookup, which is slower and costs more: it can take up to 5 minutes and run past the time limit of the MCP client. A call cut off before the answer arrives may still be charged. To get the copy that was saved in the meantime, call again without maxAgeSeconds; do not repeat a live lookup right away. The result has the v3 answer in `data`, the credits charged for the call in `creditCost` and the `requestId` to quote to support. Fields with no value (null, empty lists, empty objects, empty text) are left out of `data`; for an optional section, a missing field means it found nothing or was not asked for. An answer is never longer than 24,000 bytes: if the full answer is longer, `data` keeps every field and every list that fits, and each list it leaves out is named in `more` with its number of items, its approximate size, its number of pages and a `cursor` for get_more. A list that is in `data` is always complete. Reading a page with get_more is a new lookup and is charged.

acquisitions.description: Include the companies acquired and the acquirer, returned in the `acquisitions` section. Default: exclude.

activities.description: Include up to 100 of the most recent posts from the company page, newest first with undated posts last, returned in the `activities` section. Default: exclude.

exitData.description: Include the exit events, returned in the `exits` section. Default: exclude.

extra.description: Include the extra profile details: the Crunchbase URL, rounds count, total funding and investor count in the `funding.summary` section, the ticker symbol and IPO status in the `stock` section, and the contact email and Crunchbase link in the `contactInformation` section, and the Crunchbase slug in `slug.crunchbase`. Default: exclude.

fundingData.description: Include the funding rounds, returned in the `funding.rounds` section, and the date and type of the last round in the `funding.summary` section. Default: exclude.

maxAgeSeconds.description: Maximum acceptable age of cached data, in seconds. Default: 2592000.

url.description: Company or showcase page URL to look up.
